verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents its own recurring capability: monitors that watch a page, sitemap, or structured dataset on a schedule and emit signed change events. That scheduling is limited to change monitoring rather than general recurring jobs or workflows. Async batch crawls are one-off background jobs, not recurring schedules, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows (e.g. recurring crawls, extracts, or scrapes), details on cron/interval configuration, schedule management controls, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Watch a page, sitemap, or structured dataset on a schedule and receive signed change events.
